samir_sec: Quick flag: spike in TLS handshake rejects from ap-southeast ingest -> svc-realtime around 2026-11-02T07:12Z. Errors show client cert CN=svc-replay-old. Might be related to the recent keystore IAM regrouping.

jo_sre: Can you paste a short log snippet? Also can someone check KMS decrypt audit for the realtime keystore during rotation window?

samir_sec: ingress excerpt:
```
2026-11-02T07:11:59Z ingress-aps-2 svc-realtime=\"svc-realtime-01\" tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate (client CN=svc-replay-old, expected svc-realtime)
2026-11-02T07:12:03Z ingress-aps-1 svc-realtime=\"svc-realtime-02\" tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate (client CN=svc-replay-old, expected svc-realtime)
```

marta_infra: We ran keystore regroup on 2026-11-01 to move explicit SA grants into group keystore-admins. There were previous emergency overrides at project level; terraform might not have purged them. I'll fetch KMS audit.

kms-audit-bot: audit: decrypt events for key "keystore-realtime-aps" 2026-11-02T03:29:50Z..2026-11-02T03:33:00Z:
```
2026-11-02T03:30:01Z principal=svc-replay-old@infra.redwood action=Decrypt resource=.../keystore-realtime-key
2026-11-02T03:30:02Z principal=rotator-sa@infra.redwood action=Decrypt resource=.../keystore-realtime-key
```

jo_sre: That shows svc-replay-old still had decrypt rights and could have minted certs during rotation. Explains CN mismatch.

samir_sec: Immediate mitigation proposal: 1) Marta remove any project-level IAM entries granting decrypt for svc-replay-old, 2) run a canary rotation using rotator-sa only, 3) smoke test TLS CNs from ap-southeast probe, 4) add a monitoring rule to alert on KMS Decrypt by principals outside allowed list for keystore-* keys.

marta_infra: Removing binding now and will reconcile terraform state. I'll also add a small post-apply check to CI to assert keystore IAM parity.

kms-audit-bot: note: removed iam member svc-replay-old@infra.redwood from key keystore-realtime-aps at 2026-11-02T07:20:18Z (operator=marta_infra).

raul_devex: rotator canary queued: rotator: starting canary rotation keystore-realtime-aps-20261102-canary using rotator-sa@infra.redwood

kms-audit-bot: rotation: canary completed at 2026-11-02T03:31:40Z, issued certs CN=svc-realtime (principal=rotator-sa@infra.redwood).

jo_sre: ap-southeast TLS probe `openssl s_client -connect svc-realtime.aps.internal:443` shows handshake succeeds and client cert CN=svc-realtime accepted. Rejects fell to baseline after 07:22Z.

samir_sec: Root cause = stale project-level IAM grant left after regrouping; contributing factor = no alert on unexpected KMS decrypt principals. Follow-ups: Marta to purge orphan terraform state entry and open PR with terraform guardrail; Sec to add the KMS decrypt alert and weekly summary; DevEx to propose rotator pre-check to fail if non-rotator principals can decrypt.

marta_infra: Will open PR today to remove orphan state and add a CI test for IAM parity.

raul_devex: I'll draft the rotator pre-check RFC and make it opt-in for emergency scenarios.

samir_sec: Filing P2 incident and adding timeline + audit excerpts to the security tracker. If anyone sees similar symptoms in other regions, ping here and we'll reuse this checklist. :thumbsup:
